name: Neuropsychiatric Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Psychiatric Manifestations

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: American College of Rheumatology Neuropsychiatric SLE Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of mood disorder including depression or mania not explained by other causes
Psychotic episodes characterized by hallucinations or delusions without other psychiatric diagnosis
Unprovoked seizures not attributable to other causes
Documented cognitive impairment affecting memory, attention, or executive function
Presence of lupus-specific autoantibodies (e.g., anti-dsDNA, anti-Sm)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: At least one major neuropsychiatric manifestation in the context of systemic lupus erythematosus with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of infections, metabolic causes, and medication effects

pathognomonic.notes: Hallucinations and delusions directly attributable to CNS lupus

common.symptomName: Mood disorders including depression and mania

imaging: MRI brain showing white matter lesions or infarcts
SPECT or PET demonstrating hypoperfusion in affected areas
genetic: No specific genetic marker; associated with HLA-DR2 and HLA-DR3 haplotypes
other: CSF analysis may show mild pleocytosis or elevated protein

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of infectious agent in CSF
Fever and systemic signs of infection
Less prominent mood or psychotic symptoms

redFlags: Sudden onset of seizures or psychosis
Signs of CNS infection or increased intracranial pressure
references: American College of Rheumatology Ad Hoc Committee on Neuropsychiatric Lupus Nomenclature. The American College of Rheumatology nomenclature and case definitions for neuropsychiatric lupus syndromes. Arthritis Rheum. 1999 Apr;42(4):599-608.
Hanly JG. Diagnosis and management of neuropsychiatric SLE. Nat Rev Rheumatol. 2014 Jun;10(6):338-47.
Bertsias GK, Ioannidis JP, Boletis J, et al. EULAR recommendations for the management of systemic lupus erythematosus with neuropsychiatric manifestations. Ann Rheum Dis. 2010 Dec;69(12):2074-82.
